info.title: BookEasy API
info.summary: REST API for appointment booking and master/client management
info.description: BookEasy REST API for beauty-service booking. Includes auth (email/password and Google), public booking flows, client and master booking management, master profile/services/time-slots/statistics, billing/subscription, shared booking utilities, Telegram integration, and payment webhooks.

post.summary: Creates an anonymous booking for the specified specialist.
post.description: Registers a guest appointment without prior authentication. Verifies that the specialist accepts online bookings, validates the requested services and available time slots, resolves an existing customer profile by phone number or creates a new one, and ensures slot durations cover service requirements.

201.description: The persisted appointment details with an obfuscated tracking token.

404.description: Not Found: Specialist workspace, selected catalog services, or requested available time slots do not exist.

409.description: Conflict: Online booking is disabled for the specialist, customer contact details conflict with an existing record, or the target interval collides with existing appointments.

422.description: Unprocessable Content: Customer is blocked by the specialist, cumulative slot duration is insufficient for selected services, creation deadline has passed, or invalid payload parameters were provided.

500.description: Internal Server Error: Unexpected system failure

503.description: Service Unavailable: Service is temporarily unavailable
